messages:
Ravi (Finance): Thanks for the good discussion in AH about runway and spend controls. Opening this thread for any follow-ups or clarifying questions. Drop short asks and I'll reply.
Elena (Product): Two quick asks: 1) what's the 'stress' runway number we should plan against for new initiatives? 2) are small experiment budgets still OK?
Ravi (Finance): Stress runway = 9 months (assumes 20% downside on ARR and hiring pause). Small experiment budgets: yes, we keep a $40k/month cross-org pool for validated experiments (manager + finance lead signoff).
Marco (Eng): For infra teams: if we need to prepay a 3-month Dedicated reserve to lock pricing, does that count as committed spend immediately? How will that affect team-level caps?
Ravi (Finance): Prepayments are treated as committed cash outflows when paid and will be visible on the "committed" snapshot. For team-level monthly caps, we'll pro-rate the prepayment over the covered months for operational reporting, but cash impact is immediate on company runway.
Nadia (FP&A): Action: I'll post two scenario spreadsheets (base + stress) in #all-hands-followups by EOD with line items for headcount, infra, and vendor commitments.
Ivy (People Ops): If we enact a temporary hiring pause, what's the expected communication cadence? Managers need clear guidance to tell candidates.
Ravi (Finance): People Ops will publish a hiring FAQ template. Short version: we pause new requisitions immediately; approved exceptions can be granted for mission-critical roles with VP approval. We aim to respond to candidates within 5 business days.
Elena (Product): Clarify procurement SLAs: a team had a contract stuck in Legal for >3 weeks last quarter and it blocked a pilot. Any fast-track options?
procurement-bot: Reminder: faster reviews enabled for "sales-critical" or "time-sensitive" vendors. Use the form: https://vendor.redwood.internal/fast-track.
Ravi (Finance): Legal + Procurement agreed to a "time-sensitive" lane: sales/product can mark requests, Legal commits to 48-72h initial review if all required docs are attached.
Marco (Eng): Emergency infra overages happen. What's the fastest approval path to avoid incidents?
Ravi (Finance): Emergency path: manager posts in #spend-approvals with subject line "EMERGENCY", pings finance on-call. Finance can approve up to $30k temp allowance with a 48h mitigation plan. Anything above escalates to VP review.
Elena (Product): For Optimize A/B experiments switching a small % traffic to quantized models, do we need explicit finance approval?
Ravi (Finance): If projected monthly savings >$5k or quality risk > 2% regression, submit a one-paragraph cost/quality tradeoff to #eng-runtime and cc finance. Low-risk small pilots ok to proceed with post-hoc reporting.
Sam (CEO): Two priorities: 1) keep revenue experiments unblocked, 2) avoid long-term commitments that harm flexibility. Finance, please publish a one-pager that managers can use to evaluate "deal vs tradeoff" decisions.
Ravi (Finance): Will do. I'll include a simple checklist: expected payback window, cash timing, data access needs, and fallback if quality drops.
Nadia (FP&A): Also adding a weekly "upcoming cash obligations" digest every Monday so teams can see upcoming prepayments. procurement-bot will post it.
procurement-bot: Posted: "Upcoming committed obligations" https://files.redwood/finance/upcoming-2026-03-23.pdf
Ivy (People Ops): For contractor renewals: how are those handled under the pause?
Ravi (Finance): Contractor renewals for critical roles allowed up to 2 months with manager + director signoff. Otherwise, renewals deferred pending next spend review.
Marco (Eng): OK thanks. Can you also share a sample emergency mitigation template so teams can fill quickly?
Ravi (Finance): I'll attach a two-paragraph template in #spend-approvals. One-paragraph explanation + 3-step mitigation timeline.
Elena (Product): Great. When can we expect the public doc?
Ravi (Finance): I'll post the FAQ, the spend checklist, and links to scenario sheets to #all-hands-followups by tomorrow noon PST and pin them.
Sam (CEO): Thanks Ravi/Nadia/Ivy. Leaders: please read the one-pager and communicate the experiment budget rules to your teams.
Ravi (Finance): Thanks everyone 10 If any manager wants a 1:1 run-through of their team's spend profile, book time with FP&A (link in the slides).
